detail: ticket 2: first merge failed, 1 merge failure(s), 11 steps; recall showed 8 fact(s)

memories_after: [Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, PowerShell Format-Hex on a reports/ or deliverables/ file is the way to verify the raw first bytes and confirm no BOM precedes the 'Owner: docs-team' line.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"language":"powershell","os":"windows"}) In Windows PowerShell, Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a UTF-8 BOM at the start of the file; to produce UTF-8 without a BOM, use [IO.File]::WriteAllLines or [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText with UTF8Encoding($false) (or -Encoding utf8NoBOM on PowerShell 7) when a file must start with exact text; this is the reliable fix when a byte-exact first-line check fails.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project enforces a pre-merge check that compares the first line of reports/ and deliverables/ documents exactly and rejects team documents whose first line is not 'Owner: docs-team'; files under reports/ and deliverables/ must be saved as UTF-8 without a byte-order mark, because a leading BOM makes 'Owner: docs-team' fail the byte-exact check.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, when first creating any file under deliverables/ or reports/, write 'Owner: docs-team' as the exact first line before the content, so the pre-merge check passes on the first attempt instead of after a reopen.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, the owning team for deliverables is 'docs-team'.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document placed in deliverables/ or reports/ must name its owning team on its first line as exactly 'Owner: docs-team'.
